summary: On paper Jacksonville has the edge (Jacksonville ranks 5th in EPA per dropback, +0.21). Under center, Trevor Lawrence ranks 4th of 30 in EPA per dropback and Daniel Jones ranks 26th; x-factor: Parker Washington gets 25% of Jacksonville's targets and 38% of its air yards, and Indianapolis' pass defense ranks 24th. The model favors Jacksonville at 72%, mostly on passing matchup (3.3 pts) and starting QB (2.9 pts).
